messages:
Zoe: hey team, literally day 0 here  I need to demo a staging feature tomorrow and only need to flip one flag briefly. Is there a fast path for one-off access?
Marco: welcome Zoe! fastest is a temporary session via access-requests. If your Okta claims haven't landed, ping people-ops & infra and request a 2hr temp session.
Zoe: Request access in Console greys out the option for me. how do I check claims?
Marco: Console -> /me shows your claims, or curl the /api/v1/me endpoint with your SSO token. If you don't have admin:request claim, people-ops needs to add it.
Zoe: ok. I'm not sure how to get my SSO token. first-week newbie probs :sweat_smile:
IRIS-bot: Quick tip: SSO token is the browser session token. From chrome devtools -> Application -> Cookies -> find "sso_session" and copy for curl testing. Use with care.
people-ops: Hi Zoe, we can fast-track if you include manager approval and the demo window time. Submit the internal form: https://redwood.internal/access-requests -> choose "temporary-admin" and attach the runbook. Tag @people-ops for priority.
Zoe: thanks! manager approved and runbook attached. demo window 09:00-11:00 UTC tomorrow. flag name: internal-demo-ux.
Marco: once infra approves, you'll get a vault path to a short-lived token. Use Console -> Flags -> API examples to run the toggle; prefer the API method with note/expiry.
Zoe: sample curl?
Marco: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/flags/internal-demo-ux/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"on","expiry":"2026-03-26T11:00:00Z","note":"demo - revert after"}'
```
IRIS-bot: Access request AR-991 created for Zoe. Status: pending people-ops review :hourglass:
Zoe: great, thanks everyone. tagging @Marco if I need help reverting quickly during the demo. excited to be here! :wave:
